verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official CLI (Wally). The docs say the same CLI runs small local models offline without an account, and that one command points a tool at a model and starts it. That implies the CLI can fetch and select models, but no CLI search, download, list or delete commands are documented. The detailed download-progress API belongs to the Swift SDK, not the CLI. missing for 10: documented CLI model search, explicit CLI download command, CLI list/remove model management, independent hands-on corroboration of model handling via CLI.
